title: DACH 2026 Residential Heating Open Dataset & Engine: Firewood (RM/SRM/FM), Oil Tank Geometry (DIN 6608) & BEHG CO2 Fuel Costs
description: Open CC BY 4.0 datasets (JSON/CSV) and zero-dependency ESM JavaScript formulas published by HeizRechner (heizrechner.com) for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (2026 baseline). Covers 15 firewood species calorific values and RM/SRM/FM conversions (https://heizrechner.com/brennholz/), exact DIN 6608 / PE / spherical heating-oil tank dipstick geometry (https://heizrechner.com/oeltank/), and 2026 four-fuel heating cost comparisons including Germany's BEHG CO2 pricing (https://heizrechner.com/brennstoff-vergleich/).
